title: Glowing aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- fuselage -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#bdeeff'/>
    <!-- cockpit -->
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='49' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3a8fc4'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='47' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#9be3ff'/>
    <!-- wing (upper) -->
    <path d='M48 50 L28 26 L40 26 L60 50 Z' fill='#4fb8e8'/>
    <!-- wing (lower) -->
    <path d='M48 52 L28 76 L40 76 L60 52 Z' fill='#4fb8e8'/>
    <!-- tail fin -->
    <path d='M18 52 L12 28 L22 29 L26 52 Z' fill='#3fa4d6'/>
    <path d='M18 51 L15 34 L22 35 L24 51 Z' fill='#a8ecff'/>
    <!-- tail wing -->
    <path d='M17 52 L8 62 L16 62 L24 52 Z' fill='#8edcff'/>
    <!-- glowing lights -->
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#fff7a8'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='4.5' fill='#fff7a8' opacity='0.35'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#fff7a8'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='4' fill='#fff7a8' opacity='0.35'/>
    <!-- windows -->
    <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#eafaff'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#eafaff'/>
    <!-- glow under plane -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#fff7a8' opacity='0.18'/>
  </g>
</svg>
